title: Mum's Youngest — EN/ES/FR (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 100bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling English Spanish French language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The youngest one grows up watching two ahead
He learned from every move they made
But Joel always had his own direction
A quieter path, a different kind of brave

[Verse 2 — Español]
Fue a Zimbabwe, volvió con Kerri [He went to Zimbabwe, came home with Kerri]
Le dije — hijo, ¿es ella la indicada? Él solo sonrió [I said — son, is this the one? He just smiled]
Ella es de una granja, sus padres Jeff y Jill [She's from a farm, her parents Jeff and Jill]
Y ahora tienen una hija que canta como yo no vi [And now they have a daughter who sings unlike anything I've seen]

[Chorus — English]
My youngest one, the one who went the furthest
My youngest one, the one who found his first
Ari's got a voice that stops the morning
My youngest one — I always knew you'd learn

[Bridge — Français]
Il m'a appelé depuis l'hôpital un jour [He rang me from the hospital once]
Il a dit — Maman, Jack m'a eu avec le kart [He said — Mum, Jack got me on the buggy bad]
J'ai dit — Joel, ce n'est pas comme ça qu'on conduit un kart [I said — Joel, that's not how you drive a buggy]
Il a dit — Maman, je ne conduisais pas, c'était Jack [He said — Mum, I wasn't driving, it was Jack]

[Verse 3 — English]
His Oma's voice is somewhere in his singing
That's how you know — he was never alone

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
The gardens still growing
El jardín sigue creciendo [The garden is still growing]
Le jardin pousse encore [The garden is still growing]
My youngest one
